test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. B is sitting third to the right of F. F is an immediate neighbour of both C and A. C sits second to the right of B. D is not the immediate neighbour of C. Who is sitting to the immediate left of E?
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) B is sitting third to the right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d35e39583e0ee262b8da8fc0b75a70508d7b78daa3a853e1ffc3575558d09996.png] 

2) F is an immediate neighbour of both C and A.

3) C sits second to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2188791d4c9b46300a61850ce2eb6deb2709c8ab2cbb114c0ee0a2b9609c6338.png] 

4) D is not the immediate neighbour of C.

After positioning D only position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15150daeecdec1839e8ab2957705d2fc1396b677cbcbfd4bd8c0fc9fc231b90c.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, B is sitting to the immediate left of E.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
